title: Knight's Stained Glass Vision
description: A black silhouette of a knight standing in a body of water reaches upward with an open hand toward floating upside-down houses suspended in a purple night sky. The entire scene is framed within a vibrant arched stained glass window with a colorful border, featuring red poppies, a white lotus, purple irises, two elephants, a leafless tree, and a large glowing moon.
prompt: A surreal stained glass window scene with a black silhouette knight standing in reflective water, reaching up toward a purple night sky containing several upside-down floating houses. A large glowing moon illuminates the scene. The foreground shows red poppies, a white lotus flower, and purple irises. Two elephants stand in the water in the midground. A bare tree grows beside the knight. The entire composition is framed by a colorful arched stained glass border with lead lines.
